title: Spectral Asymptotics of a Singular Harmonic Oscillator with Aharonov--Bohm Flux
summary: Motivated by a recent article of R. Vanlaere (2026), we investigate the spectral asymptotics of a singular harmonic oscillator arising from the radial reduction of the magnetic Schrödinger operator on the unit disk in the presence of a constant magnetic field and an Aharonov-Bohm flux. The corresponding eigenvalue problem is equivalent to the study of the zeros of the Kummer confluent hypergeometric function with respect to its first parameter.
